plugins.name: Admin
plugins.description: Guided server setup, core configuration, plugin enable/disable, permission auditing, and bot health — the platform's always-on control plane.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Guided server setup and setup status.

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Show what has been configured so far.

options.name: value
options.description: New value ("none" clears a nullable field)

subcommands.name: reset
subcommands.description: Reset a configuration key to its default.

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Show a plugin's status, or every plugin's if none is given.

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List every plugin, grouped by category.

commands.name: permissions
commands.description: Audit bot permissions and configuration health.

subcommands.name: audit
subcommands.description: Run a permissions and configuration audit.

commands.name: health
commands.description: Show the bot's health and per-plugin status.

plugins.name: Moderation
plugins.description: Warnings, timeouts, kicks, bans, cases, and the moderator hierarchy — the platform's core moderation toolkit.

plugins.name: Automod
plugins.description: Configurable automated moderation rules — spam, mentions, invites, word filters — with dry-run mode and a false-positive review queue.

plugins.name: Enforcer
plugins.description: Policy-driven, hands-off moderation: the bot flags possible violations from a server policy and a moderator decides — everything is bookkept in a read-only ledger and the database.

plugins.name: Logging
plugins.description: Routes member, message, role, and moderation events to configured log channels, with retention and CSV export.

plugins.name: Tickets
plugins.description: Button-driven support tickets with categories, staff assignment, tags, and HTML/JSON transcripts.

plugins.name: Roles & Onboarding
plugins.description: Role panels, welcome/goodbye messages, onboarding checklists, and member verification.

plugins.name: Engagement
plugins.description: Leveling/XP with anti-farming controls, leaderboards, reputation, and the starboard.

plugins.name: Community
plugins.description: Polls, giveaways, suggestions, scheduled announcements, reminders, and event RSVPs.

plugins.name: Economy
plugins.description: Virtual currency economy (balance, daily, give, leaderboard) — no real-money functionality. Disabled by default.

plugins.name: Utility
plugins.description: General-purpose utility commands: user/server info, timestamps, reminders, translation, weather, and more.

plugins.name: Music & Media
plugins.description: Playlist and queue management for a legal, user-authorized audio source. Unavailable unless MEDIA_PROVIDER names a compliant provider — no YouTube scraping, stream ripping, or copyright bypassing.

plugins.name: Integrations
plugins.description: Secure connector framework for optional external services: Twitch, YouTube, GitHub, Reddit, Steam, Google/Microsoft Calendar, Notion, Stripe, and generic webhooks.

plugins.name: AI Assistant
plugins.description: Optional, disabled-by-default AI helper (/ask, /summarize, /draft, /mod-assist) with per-server opt-in and per-channel allowlisting.
